title: Claims Desk Notice: Late Manufacturer Copay Card Reimbursement Claims — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
The late-claim handling of a Manufacturer Copay Card reimbursement under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs follows the calendar days from the fill date to today:

- **more than 90 days** — the reimbursement so far is multiplied by **0.95** and rounded to the cent half up;
- **31 to 90 days** — a flat **20.00 dollars** is withheld from it;
- **30 days or fewer** — it is left as it is.

The reimbursement so far is the claim's patient pay limited to the reimbursement limit, less the reimbursement minimum pay. The late-claim handling is applied to that amount before the result is held to the benefit dollars left on the program.

| Calendar days from the fill date to today | Handling |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | none |
| 31 to 90 | $20.00 withheld |
| 91 or more | multiplied by 0.95, rounded half up |

**Hypothetical reimbursement so far of $795.00:** at 30 days $795.00; at 31 days $775.00; at 90 days $775.00; at 91 days $755.25.
